justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bind/MethodDelegationBinder.java and byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/MethodDelegation.java, plus the BindingResolver tests. The target is a small nested strategy interface with one method and three concrete implementations (Default, Unique, StreamWriting) and limited fan-out to AmbiguityResolver, MethodDescription, List<MethodBinding>, and PrintStream. Fan-in is also limited: in production code it is referenced by MethodDelegation (fields/constructors/appender and withBindingResolver) and MethodDelegationBinder.Processor only; the remaining references are test classes. This is not strong hub-like modularization evidence.
